_note: ADR 0010 (T1-02) — transferable METHOD nodes (method-grain, not subject-field). v1: 10 nodes after operator-ratified merges (game_theoretic_equilibrium -> equilibrium_fixed_point; dimensionality_reduction -> spectral_decomposition). 'behavioral_signature' = regex-ish patterns the T1-03 detector matches against the model's WORKED SOLUTION (behavioral; never a self-report). maxent vs bayes signatures kept disjoint per ratification.

nodes.label: Equilibrium / fixed-point / strategic equilibrium
nodes.description: Solve for states of zero net change or mutual best-response; characterize stability. Subsumes game-theoretic (Nash = best-response fixed point).

nodes.label: Compartmental / coupled-rate dynamics
nodes.description: Partition a system into stocks with flows between them; write coupled rate equations.

nodes.label: Bayesian inference / posterior updating
nodes.description: Combine PRIOR and LIKELIHOOD to update beliefs into a posterior.

nodes.label: Feedback / closed-loop control
nodes.description: Sense error against a setpoint and act to reduce it; analyze loop stability/gain.

nodes.label: Selection / variation-and-retention under constraint
nodes.description: Iteratively retain fitter variants under an objective and resource limits.

nodes.label: Network flow / connectivity / contagion
nodes.description: Model entities as a graph; reason about flow, cuts, centrality, percolation, spread.

nodes.label: Stochastic / Monte-Carlo sampling and search
nodes.description: Estimate or search by simulating random draws from a generative process.

nodes.label: Phase transition / critical phenomena
nodes.description: Identify a control parameter at which qualitative behavior changes abruptly; scaling.

nodes.label: Spectral / eigen / latent-structure decomposition
nodes.description: Decompose an operator/signal/data into eigen-, frequency-, or latent components. Subsumes dimensionality reduction (PCA).

nodes.label: Maximum-entropy / least-commitment inference
nodes.description: Choose the distribution that MAXIMIZES ENTROPY subject to known CONSTRAINTS.
